release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE10DF3T-LPXTS is an analog Turbo HD 2MP two-way-audio Smart-Hybrid-Light mini bullet with IR up to 25m, white light up to 20m, built-in mic and speaker, and a red/blue strobe plus audible alarm; verified against DS-2CE10DF3T-LPXTS_Datasheet_20250422.pdf.
